Name: Crispus
Summary: Crispus was the chief ruler of the synagogue at Corinth who believed on the Lord with all his house after Paul's preaching, and was baptised by Paul himself.
KeyStory: Crispus, the synagogue ruler, believed with all his house and was baptised by Paul's own hand.
LifeLesson: The synagogue ruler became a church member. Crispus crossed the line his office had drawn.
